```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'browser' => { 'mode' => 'never' }, 'content' => { 'exclude_selectors' => [], 'extract_metadata' => false, 'preprocessing_preset' => 'minimal', 'remove_forms' => false, 'remove_navigation' => false }, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
```
